full_track.tags: Classical orchestral waltz. The arrangement features a prominent string section with violins, violas, cellos, and double basses, alongside a woodwind section including flute, oboe, and clarinet. A harp provides arpeggiated flourishes and glissandi. The brass section consists of French horns and trumpets. Percussion includes timpani and a triangle. The piece is in 3/4 time at 160 BPM in the key of D Major. The violins lead with a soaring legato melody while the lower strings and horns emphasize the downbeat and subsequent two beats in a traditional oom-pah-pah waltz pattern. Woodwinds provide counter-melodies and trills. The dynamics shift frequently between piano and forte through crescendos and decrescendos.

[Intro]
[pizzicato strings, harp glissando]

[Main Theme]
[legato violin melody, 3/4 waltz rhythm in cellos and horns]
[flute and oboe counter-melody]

[Bridge]
[staccato woodwinds, triangle hits on the downbeat]
[crescendo with timpani roll]

[Theme Reprise]
[full orchestral tutti, fortissimo strings and brass]
[harp arpeggios]

[Outro]
[decrescendo to solo flute, final sustained D major chord in strings]
